title: Pixel-Art Metroidvania Tilemap
summary: 2D tilemap planning image with traversal gates, parallax depth, secrets, and ability locks.
prompt: Create a pixel-art metroidvania level design board for {argument name="game_title" default="Moonroot Circuit"}. Show a side-scrolling room cluster with jump arcs, ability-gated doors, hidden breakable walls, enemy placement, checkpoint room, parallax background layers, hazard rhythm, and collectible placement. Include tile size consistency, silhouette readability, and a mini flow diagram for first visit versus return visit.
